sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bron is a cross-reference in this book. It sends the reader to the entry for FISHER KING. The Fisher King is a hero of Grail legend. He sits injured in his boat and fishes. The land around him withers and dies. A lance wound in his groin left him near death. His story appears in tales of the knight Percival.
